messages:
Nina Rao: Quick question from a biz trip: I bought a local SIM at CDG (30) and also paid for in-flight wifi on the return (12). Only used the SIM for one work day and wifi only for 3 hours of email/Slack. Can I claim both? How to split?

Sophie (People Ops): Telecom and inflight wifi are reimbursable when used for work. For mixed-use, we ask you to pro-rate. Small note: if telecom > 75 get preapproval next time.

Nina Rao: OK. Do we pro-rate inflight wifi by hours used vs total flight time or by business purpose?

Rajiv (Manager): I confirm Nina used wifi for work for ~3 hours on that flight. Approving the business portion.

Alex (Accounting): For simplicity: pro-rate by reasonable business use. For SIM we typically do days-based (1 work day / total days). For inflight wifi we do hours-based pro-rate (3 hours work / flight hours). Attach both receipts and a manager note.

Expense Bot: Reminder: upload original receipts. If paid card outside EUR we'll convert at transaction rate. Use categories: "mobile-internet" and "travel-wifi".

Sophie (People Ops): Also: if the SIM came with a device or multi-month plan > 150 we need preapproval. For VAT reclaim: we only reclaim if vendor issues invoice in company name (rare for kiosks/inflight providers).

Nina Rao: Got it. So claim 1/5 days for SIM and (3/6) hours for wifi? Flight was ~6h, yes. I'll submit with Rajiv's approval.

Alex (Accounting): Sounds good. We'll process pro-rated amounts and mark non-VAT reclaimable unless you have an invoice in company name.
